stance_rationale: The forge draft is still an execution plan, not a verified package: post-recompute hashes, target alpha/covariance artifacts, updated per-name weights, and Harvey/DSR evidence are missing or marked TBD. The actual 2026-05-01 production output still rolls back to the frozen 2023-12-01 schedule, which directly contradicts the Mode_2 forward-recompute claim.

critical_concerns.description: The package records only pre-state hashes and explicitly says post-recompute verification is TBD; target qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-P20260429_002 alpha_scores.parquet and covariance.parquet do not exist, and no target risk_package.json exists in WT-P20260429_002. This is not a completed Pure Function v6.1 R12 audit.

The draft claims Mode_2 forward recompute to 2026-04/2026-05, but the actual 20260501 capacity manifest resolves as_of_date to 2023-12-01 and marks the 20260501 file as identical to 20231201. Root weights.csv has 267 strategy/cash dates, while per-name source weights still have only 181 dates ending 2023-12-01.

Current M4 active-production evidence does not include same-period, same-cost, same-DSR baseline recomputation. Harvey 5-spec and DSR are pending or absent for the current package; inherited Iter32 evidence has 0/5 Harvey specs passing and DSR_post 0.2913, which cannot support a production-grade continuation claim.

critical_concerns.description: Inherited M4 charts exist, but the Mode_2 recompute target has no new equity_curve/oos chart or Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined 3-way report. Therefore the red lockbox marker and strategy line after lockbox are not verified for the package under critique.

The 20260501 production file has 21 rows including CASH, two near-zero residual tickers, and a capacity breach on A104830 at 52.55% of ADV for AUM 10B. Ex-cash max_names and weight bounds pass, but this is not the clean 20-name recomputed May schedule the draft describes.

The package relies on phrases such as standard verification 충족, OOS 진입 자유, logic 변경 없음, input data만 신선, and admission 재심사 X while core verification fields remain TBD or pending. This is a No Silent Override failure pattern rather than evidence.

supporting_arguments: Inherited covariance at stage_artifacts/WT_D20260425_010/covariance.parquet is PSD with min eigenvalue 0.0033009419 and condition 24.340096, so the old Iter5 covariance itself passes the requested PSD/condition check; the target qepm/stage_artifacts path is still missing.
Root WT-P20260429_002 weights.csv has 267 monthly strategy/cash rows from 2004-01-01 to 2026-03-01, and inherited M4 output has equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png.
The inherited M4 overlay cost rows use turnover × 0.003, consistent with 15bps one-way round-trip ×2 for the overlay layer, so RF-F7 is not the primary failure.
The actual 20260501 per-name weights are long-only, sum to 1.0, and max weight is 0.1082; the failure is schedule provenance and capacity cleanliness, not simple weight bounds.
unresolved_disputes: Whether the intended critique target is the root forge_package_draft.json, the duplicate forge_may2026 draft, or the already-generated Mode_1 20260501 production files; these artifacts conflict.
Whether qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-P20260429_002 and stage_artifacts/WT_P20260429_002 are missing because of a path typo or because Mode_2 artifacts were never produced.
Whether May 2026 deployment should be a true forward recompute through 2026-04/2026-05 or an acknowledged frozen 2023-12-01 alias.
Which baseline is binding for RF-F4 fairness: SYN_06 replacement baseline, S1 STR_1715 baseline, Iter31 standalone, or M4 active production.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that extending SIGNAL_CUTOFF after lockbox expiry is only an input-data refresh and preserves Pure Function status, even though post hashes are TBD, target artifacts are missing, STR_1656 stale handling can alter the blend, and actual May weights remain a frozen 2023-12-01 alias.
rebuttal_required: Produce Mode_2 outputs: alpha_scores through at least 2026-04/2026-05, per-name weights schedule, post-recompute md5 hashes, and a non-rolled-back 2026-05 row.
Attach the target alpha_scores.parquet and covariance.parquet at the declared WT-P20260429_002 stage paths, or correct the package paths.
Run same-period, same-cost, same-DSR baseline comparison and Harvey 5-spec Newey-West plus DSR for the active M4 production line and the binding replacement baseline.
Resolve the STR_1656 stale-score rule as a deterministic, PIT-safe rule and classify whether it is an alpha logic change.
Regenerate May capacity evidence with no unresolved ADV breach, or explicitly downgrade production readiness.
